_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Eiríkr Magnússon (1833-1913) and William Morris (1834-1896): their Icelandic sagas. Grettir the Strong (1869), Frithiof the Bold (1875), Three Northern Love Stories (1875) and the six-volume Saga Library (1891-1905, including their Heimskringla). Their Volsunga Saga is on Lane D's poetic-edda shelf (cross-referenced here). PD everywhere. Morris's Odyssey, Aeneid and Beowulf stay on the homer, virgil and beowulf shelves. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 12); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_surname_note: Magnússon, not Morris: 'morris' alone would pass Morris dancers, Morris chairs, and other Morrises; every one of these sagas names Magnússon.

_name_words_note: Translator name only: fetch_shelf.py treats it as the identity check, so the original author's name is deliberately NOT listed.
_verified_note: Evidence that each source's rights/identity line was read (lane C review fix, 2026-10-02, pipeline run over the fetched files; no book text recorded). PG: the header's Translator: line and the COPYRIGHTED marker. IA: whether the translator's name appears in the first 30 KB of OCR, and the years printed in the first 15 KB of front matter (scanner/digitizer lines skipped). Any post-1930 year there was examined by eye; see the title's scan_edition.
